text_block_list.text:
At this Tenno Sho (Autumn), Meisho Doto 
wished not only to be acknowledged by T.M. 
Opera O, but to become her partner.

Meanwhile, Admire Vega began to vaguely 
grasp the nature of the ceiling holding 
back Meisho Doto's growth. After this 
race, everything might become clear.
